title: Junior Accounts Executive
description:
Role & responsibilities 
 General Administration: - Cross check the payments for vendors/suppliers. - Maintain the juridical Folder - Solve supplier admin queries 
 Accounting: - Coordination with CA/CS - Check the bank statement reconciliation. - Check & Pay taxes on time. - Cross check & Submit accounting Reports monthly. - Check incoming invoices and give approvals by stamping & Signing. - Monitor the bank charges as agreed with the bank. - Cross-check Telegraphic Transfer Like A2 payment. - Check inward invoices : stamp / A/C N / OK OB are correct - Check Trial Balance Analysis (TBA) report monthly and submit to Manager. - Check Profitability report monthly and submit to Manager. - Follow the Balance Sheet completion. - Review the governmental documents doc: RCMC, SHOP ACT, LUT Bond, Etc. - Coordinate with Tax Consultant Optitax - Must have experience in E-invoicing. 
 Export / Import administration: - Cross-check of all the documentation: export invoice, P/L, BLG, etc - Maintaining the records/files. - Handle Government Officers documentation queries related to accounts. - Visit Exim for DGFT work Income Tax 
 HR administration: - Check the payrolls for the staff before proceeding with payment. 
 Preferred candidate profile 
 Good Knowledge of Tally ERP and Accounting, Good English level, - Is very particular and making no mistake , Sensitive to commercial aspects (Client & Supplier), Capable make good inter department meetings, Good team-player, Time flexible and efficient, Stress resistant, Takes good initiatives and displays a pro-active attitude (Result oriented), Good knowledge of Microsoft office..

Key Skills: Tally ERP,TDS,E-Invoicing,GST Return,Invoice Processing,Accounting,E Way Bill,Export Import Documentation
